Open.note: defaultOpen renders the real portalled surface below the trigger: popover fill, hairline ring, shadow and w-72 p-3 padding, with a two-part settings summary and a success Badge inside.

MenuContent.note: Same primitive with p-1 content holding PopoverMenuItems, including a destructive row — shows the menu composition the DS actually uses.

Closed.note: Resting state: trigger button only, no surface. Correct and useful as the contrast cell.
